mapper.select: /* selectMasterClMgCreditDeptPop */ SELECT CMPY.COM_CODE , CMPY.COM_NAME_LOC , COD.ADD_DATE , COD.TEXT2 AS KEP_DEPT , (SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = COD.ADD_USER_ID) AS USER_NANE_LOC , SUBSTR(COD.TEXT3,0,3)||'-'||SUBSTR(COD.TEXT3,4,2)||'-'||SUBSTR(COD.TEXT3,6,5) IRS_NO , COD.TEXT4 AS REQ_DEPT_CD ,(SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 COD2 WHERE COD2.TYPE = 'C001' AND COD2.COMPANY_CODE = COD.CODE1 AND COD2.CODE = COD.TEXT4) AS REQ_DEPT_NM , (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(COD2.CODE),0,'N','Y') FROM ICOMCOD2 COD2 WHERE COD2.TYPE = 'BYEX' AND COD2.COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND COD2.CODE = COD.CODE1) AS BYEX_YN , COD.CODE2 , ACNT.PAY_TERMS ,(SELECT A.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 A WHERE A.TYPE = 'SA15' AND A.FLAG = 'Y' AND A.CODE = ACNT.PAY_TERMS) AS PAY_TERMS_TEXT FROM ICOMCOD3 COD , ICOMCMPY CMPY, ACNTBUYR ACNT WHERE COD.BUYER ='KRKORE0001' AND COD.TYPE = 'BYMP' AND COD.FLAG = 'Y' AND COD.CODE1 = CMPY.COM_CODE AND CMPY.COM_CODE = ACNT.BUYER(+) AND COD.CODE1 = ACNT.BUYER(+) AND COD.TEXT1 = REPLACE(#{st_irs_no},'-','') AND COD.TEXT2 = #{st_dept_cd}
mapper.update: /*insertMasterClMgCreditDeptPop*/ INSERT INTO ICOMCOD3 (BUYER ,TYPE ,CODE1 ,CODE2 ,TEXT1 ,TEXT2 ,TEXT3 ,TEXT4 ,FLAG ,ADD_USER_ID ,ADD_DATE ) VALUES ( 'KRKORE0001' ,'BYMP' ,#{COM_CODE} ,(SELECT NVL(MAX(CD.CODE2)+1,1) FROM ICOMCOD3 CD WHERE CD.TYPE = 'BYMP' AND CD.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND CD.CODE1 = #{COM_CODE}) ,REPLACE(#{st_irs_no},'-','') ,#{KEP_DEPT} ,REPLACE(#{IRS_NO},'-','') ,#{REQ_DEPT_CD} ,'Y' ,#{st_user_id} ,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') )
mapper.select: /* selectMasterClMgCreditBondPop */ SELECT SUBSTR (COD.CODE1, 1, 3) || '-'|| SUBSTR (COD.CODE1, 4, 2)|| '-'|| SUBSTR (COD.CODE1, 6) AS LOAN_IRS_NO , SUBSTR (COD.CODE2, 1, 3) || '-'|| SUBSTR (COD.CODE2, 4, 2)|| '-'|| SUBSTR (COD.CODE2, 6) AS IRS_NO , COD.TEXT4 AS IRS_NM , COD.TEXT1 AS KEP_DEPT , ADD_DATE , ADD_USER_ID , (SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = COD.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER_NAME FROM ICOMCOD3 COD WHERE COD.BUYER ='KRKORE0001' AND COD.TYPE = 'CDMP' AND COD.FLAG = 'Y' AND COD.CODE1 = REPLACE(#{st_irs_no},'-','') AND COD.TEXT1 = #{st_dept_cd}
mapper.update: /*insertMasterClMgCreditBondPop*/ INSERT INTO ICOMCOD3 (BUYER ,TYPE ,CODE1 ,CODE2 ,TEXT1 ,TEXT2 ,TEXT3 ,TEXT4 ,FLAG ,ADD_USER_ID ,ADD_DATE ) VALUES ( 'KRKORE0001' ,'CDMP' ,REPLACE(#{LOAN_IRS_NO},'-','') ,REPLACE(#{IRS_NO},'-','') ,#{KEP_DEPT} ,(SELECT COD1.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 COD1 WHERE COD1.TYPE = 'TX06' AND COD1.CODE =#{KEP_DEPT} AND COD1.FLAG = 'Y' ) ,(SELECT COD2.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 COD2 WHERE COD2.COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND COD2.TYPE ='C001' AND COD2.FLAG = 'Y' AND COD2.CODE = #{KEP_DEPT}) ,#{IRS_NM} ,'Y' ,#{st_user_id} ,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') )

/* selectMasterClMgBondExcpPop */ SELECT SUBSTR (COD.CODE1, 1, 3) || '-'|| SUBSTR (COD.CODE1, 4, 2)|| '-'|| SUBSTR (COD.CODE1, 6) AS IRS_NO , COD.CODE2 KEP_DEPT , COD.TEXT1 AS IRS_NM , COD.ADD_DATE , (SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = COD.ADD_USER_ID) ADD_USER_NAME FROM ICOMCOD3 COD WHERE BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND COD.TYPE = 'EXMP'
